title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The Decision of the AI Office outlines the official stance of the office on AI policies and regulations. It provides clear guidelines and procedures for the responsible development and deployment of AI systems within the organization.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The policy provides guidelines for filling AI technology specialist positions in the AI Office. It details the required qualifications, responsibilities, and hiring processes for these roles.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The policy announces a vacancy for the position of Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI office, describing the role’s main responsibilities and the qualifications needed. Candidates are expected to have strong scientific expertise, leadership experience, and a commitment to guiding AI research and policy development.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: The policy explains what legal officers in AI offices should do and the legal and ethical rules they must follow. It also covers how to hire and manage these officers.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The policy outlines a job opening for AI Office Policy Officers, explaining the duties, required qualifications, and application process. It emphasizes the role’s focus on shaping and enforcing AI governance, compliance, and ethical standards.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts tasked with reviewing the scientific and technical aspects of the proposed AI regulations. Their work ensures that the policies are based on up‑to‑date research, best practices, and realistic technical feasibility.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The Draft Standardisation Request is a preliminary document aimed at establishing uniform guidelines for AI development and deployment. It calls for collaboration among industry, academia, and regulators to create clear standards and best practices.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces a consultation with the Community of Practice (CoP) about developing or updating AI policy. It invites members and stakeholders to review the proposals and share their feedback to help shape the policy framework.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: The document invites individuals or organizations to express interest in joining a Community of Practice related to AI policy. It outlines the purpose of the community, the topics it will cover, and what participants can expect to contribute.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: It explains how policies are created through a cycle of drafting, feedback, and revision, showing that the process is ongoing rather than one‑off. The graphic provides a step‑by‑step visual guide that helps a community of practice members see how each version of a policy builds on the previous ones.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This document presents a visual timeline of the drafting process for the AI policy. It shows key milestones, dates, and the sequence of steps involved in creating the policy.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: The “Code of Practice: 1st Draft” outlines a set of guidelines and best practices for the responsible design, deployment, and use of artificial intelligence within an organization. It emphasizes principles such as transparency, fairness, accountability, and continuous monitoring to ensure AI systems operate safely and ethically.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document outlines a set of guidelines for responsible AI use, covering principles like transparency, fairness, and accountability. It serves as a reference for organizations to implement best practices in AI development and deployment.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document is the third draft of a set of guidelines for the responsible design, deployment, and use of AI systems. It provides principles and best‑practice recommendations for developers, businesses, and regulators to promote transparency, fairness, safety, and accountability in AI.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: This draft AI Pact outlines a collaborative agreement to govern the development and use of artificial intelligence systems. It seeks to establish shared principles, ethical standards, and safety protocols for AI technologies among participating parties.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a collaborative agreement between governments and organizations to create shared rules for the safe and fair use of artificial intelligence. It outlines standards for transparency, accountability, and oversight to ensure AI technologies benefit society while minimizing risks.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: The guidelines describe which activities and uses of AI are not allowed. They set rules to help developers avoid unsafe or unethical AI practices.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This policy explains how to define an AI system, detailing the technical features, capabilities, and context that qualify a system as AI. It provides clear criteria and terminology for classifying AI systems to ensure consistent understanding and compliance across organizations.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines strategies to communicate and support the growth of start‑ups and foster innovation in the sector. It emphasizes collaboration, funding, and knowledge sharing to create an ecosystem where new companies can thrive.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups is a European program that gives early‑stage companies access to high‑performance computing resources, helping them develop new technologies and compete globally. It also offers training, mentorship, and funding support to boost innovation and accelerate growth in the HPC sector.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: The slideshow webinar explains how organizations can identify, assess, and manage risks associated with AI systems. It covers best practices for monitoring, mitigation, and governance to ensure responsible AI deployment.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar covers key concepts and strategies for effective risk management in various settings. It discusses tools and best practices to identify, assess, and mitigate potential risks.
